review_domain: security / tenancy / auth / validation / data handling
phase: Phase 2: Reading Advantage Critical Security and XP Idempotency

findings.title: Classroom enroll controller lacked ownership/tenant authorization
findings.evidence: patchClassroomEnroll in apps/reading-advantage/server/controllers/classroom-controller.ts performed the classroomStudents insert without verifying the caller owned the target classroom or was a same-school admin/SYSTEM.
findings.fix: Extracted shared canModifyClassroom helper (owner || same-school ADMIN || SYSTEM) and applied it to deleteClassroom, patchClassroomUnenroll, and patchClassroomEnroll. Added getCurrentUser authentication check and an audit event for enroll mutations.
findings.test_evidence: Extended __tests__/controllers/classroom-authorization.test.ts with cross-school enroll rejection, owner enroll success, and aggregated 3-forbidden count across delete/unenroll/enroll.

findings.title: System-key comparison was not constant-time and read raw process.env
findings.evidence: assertSystemAccess in apps/reading-advantage/server/middleware/system-key.ts used 'supplied !== configured' and read process.env.ACCESS_KEY directly, exposing a timing side-channel and bypassing env validation.
findings.fix: Replaced comparison with crypto.timingSafeEqual after length check; added Zod validation (non-empty string) so empty/invalid values fail closed; added case-sensitivity coverage.
findings.test_evidence: Added __tests__/controllers/system-key-gate.test.ts proving missing/wrong/empty keys are rejected and the correct key proceeds.

findings.title: Legacy restrictAccessKey middleware uses non-constant-time compare and raw process.env.ACCESS_KEY
findings.evidence: apps/reading-advantage/server/controllers/auth-controller.ts restrictAccessKey still uses 'accessKey !== process.env.ACCESS_KEY' and is used by the Cloud Scheduler route wrappers.
findings.fix: Not fixed in this phase to avoid scope creep; should be aligned with assertSystemAccess (constant-time compare + validated env + minimum length) in Wave 4 (Reading SEC-6..10 per coverage matrix).
findings.test_evidence: N/A — pre-existing, no new tests added.

A2_consent_blind_publish.detail: Phase 2 did not touch any draft→published publish gate or user-generated content approval flow. No consent/publish surface was modified.

A6_registry_overstatement.detail: measure/tracks.md and plan.md claims for Phase 2 (26/26 targeted tests pass, auth/tenant/audit gates implemented) match the actual green gate result. No security state is claimed resolved beyond the adversarial tests that pass.

verified_controls.control: Audit events emitted for destructive operations
Level-test assessment JSON validated with Zod
AI content quality gate rejects off-level articles

handoff: Phase 2 Green security review is complete. All blocking findings introduced or directly adjacent to the Phase 2 changed surface have been fixed and tested. One pre-existing Low finding (restrictAccessKey timing/env validation) is deferred to Wave 4. The targeted Phase 2 gate exits 0 with 34 tests across 7 suites. Remaining classroom/assignment/article destructive endpoints that were not part of the Phase 2 representative slice continue to be owned by Wave 4 per the coverage matrix.
